text_block_list.text:
After lunch, I find Сайленс Судзука staring
at her
empty plate.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: My next race is coming up. What to do...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer... I'm trying to decide
whether I
should eat dessert or not.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
This time of the year, they have all kinds
of
winter-themed sweets. They call it the
Snow Fair.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I don't think I've ever seen so many
gorgeous
frosty treats in one place!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: The presentation makes them look extra tasty!

text_block_list.text:
I'm especially interested in this one, the
Igloo
Jumbo Parfait.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
But with the next race coming up, I have
to really
be careful about my intake...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: Don't worry about it. Time to indulge!

text_block_list.text: Are you sure? Thank you so much!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's so cute. It's almost a shame to
eat it.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Well if you say so, it must be okay.
Right?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: You can run off whatever you eat later.

text_block_list.text:
Hm... I can eat as much as I want... and
then run as
much as I want.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: It's a win-win situation, isn't it? Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
She was right to be concerned. This
parfait must
be packed with calories.
The snow is more likely
to give her
heartburn than frostbite.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
